QuestInfo.1: You need to prove yourself to Koko, who refuses to work under anyone weak.\r\n#kGo defeat 20 Elite Monsters.#k

default.0: There are some giant monsters that roam around with the regular ones. Elite Monsters, they call 'em. Take down a few hundred of those, and then we'll talk.
